subject: Clash between latex mathastext package and tikzdevice in knitr

messages.author: 4326e8dca5f40560
messages.subject: Clash between latex mathastext package and tikzdevice in knitr
parts:
Hello,

I'd like (1) to have my figures drawn  with tikz (through option dev='tikz'), and (2) harmonize the math font of the LaTeX document using XeLaTeX as the LaTeX compiler.
 
However when using  \usepackage{mathastext} in order to get the same font in math as in the normal text, I get an error from tikzdevice:

"Error in getMetricsFromLatex(TeXMetrics)"

Commenting out the first line in the preamble solves the issue but the math font is then different from the text font:

% \usepackage{mathastext}
\PassOptionsToPackage{no-math}{fontspec}
\usepackage{fontspec}

Thanks in advance for any help,
Jacques

messages.author: 4326e8dca5f40560
messages.subject: Re: Clash between latex mathastext package and tikzdevice in knitr
parts:
Hello

I answer my own question to which I've found the solution in the vignette of tikzDevice...
What is needed is to adjust the tikz options for Xelatex as in the following :

options(
tikzXelatexPackages =
c("\usepackage{tikz} ",
"\usepackage[active,tightpage,xetex]{preview} ",
"\PassOptionsToPackage{no-math}{fontspec} ",
"\usepackage{fontspec,xunicode} ",
"\usepackage{mathastext} ",
"\PreviewEnvironment{pgfpicture} ",
"\setlength\PreviewBorder{0pt} "
))

Regards,
Jacques
